name: Gray-headed Robin
rangeDescription: Rainforest of northern queensland (cooktown to mount spec)
description: Large, plump robin of montane rainforest. Both sexes olive brown above, with gray crown and breast, stark white throat, and white wing patch, prominent in flight.

name: Golden-naped Barbet
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern borneo
description: The highest-ranging of Borneo’s endemic barbets, found in montane forest from 1000 m up to 3000 m or more. Stunning emerald-green with neon-powder-blue crown and throat; namesake golden nape only visible from certain angles.

name: Colima Warbler
rangeDescription: Western texas (chisos mountains) to central mexico
description: Rather drab warbler of highlands in Mexico. Dusky gray-brown overall with grayer head, bold white eyering, buffy flanks, and mustard-yellow undertail coverts.

name: Cinnamon Screech-Owl
rangeDescription: Cloud forest of southern ecuador to northern peru
description: Small screech-owl with a scattered distribution in the Andes. It inhabits cloud forest in southeastern Ecuador and northern Peru, as well as a few locations in Colombia and Venezuela.

name: Rimatara Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Rimatara (tubuai islands)
description: A large warbler with a yellowish eyebrow and a dark eye-stripe. Crown and upperparts warm olive-brown.

name: Brazilian Merganser
rangeDescription: South-central south america (paraguai-paraná drainage system)
description: Unmistakable in range. Odd-looking duck with a long thin bill, dark green head, and spiky crest.

name: Lesser Antillean Euphonia
rangeDescription: Lesser antilles
description: Endemic to the Lesser Antilles. A brilliantly colored, tiny, and active species of dense woodlands where it feeds at middle to upper levels, primarily on mistletoe berries.

name: Cinnamon-faced Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Andean foothills of central and southeastern peru and adjacent northern bolivia
description: Small yellowish tyrannulet with a narrow reddish facial patch. Usually perches horizontally in the mid-story and canopy of humid montane forest.

name: Gray-banded Munia
rangeDescription: Northwestern new guinea (arfak mountains)
description: A very localised but locally common, small bird of mid-montane grasslands on the Bird’s Head of New Guinea. Gray-brown back, pale gray head, white face, yellow rump and tail.

name: Lake Duck
rangeDescription: Breeds southern argentina and chile; winters northward to southern brazil and paraguay
description: Fairly common locally on lakes with surrounding reeds and wetlands with open water; spends much time sleeping. The lowland counterpart to the very similar Andean Duck; the two species may occur together in a few places, but Andean Duck is rare in lowlands, where Lake Duck is the default species.

name: Large Blue Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Breeds eastern himalayas (northeastern india and bhutan) to northern myanmar; winters southern myanmar and thai-malay peninsula
description: Typical blue flycatcher; male is bright blue above and orange below, while female is grayish-brown above with a light orange suffusion on her pale belly. Breeds in eastern Himalayan foothill forests and winters in more open habitat in lowlands of Thai-Malay peninsula.

name: Germain's Peacock-Pheasant
rangeDescription: Humid forest of southern vietnam
description: Small compact brown pheasant with bright red facial skin and iridescent sapphire spots all over the body, with longer green spots on the tail. Inhabits forests with dense cover from the lowlands up into the foothills and lower montane areas.

name: Cook's Swift
rangeDescription: Lowland myanmar, thailand, vietnam, southern yunnan, and guangxi (southwestern and southeastern china); winters at least to peninsular malaysia
description: Large dark swift with long sickle-shaped wings and a forked tail, which is often kept closed in a needle-tipped point while in flight. Black overall with an ashy gray throat and a thin white rump.

name: Freckled Duck
rangeDescription: Locally in far southwestern and southeastern australia
description: Very finely-speckled dark-grayish duck with a dark eye and an obvious peaked crown. Beak is strongly curved like a ski-jump.

name: Orange-bellied Parrot
rangeDescription: Breeds southwestern tasmania; winters to coastal southeastern australia
description: Small grassy-green parrot that feeds on the ground. Bright green and yellow with blue wings and yellow lower belly with a central orange patch, yellowish throat, and thin mid-blue line between eyes.

name: Rwenzori Batis
rangeDescription: Eastern democratic republic of the congo to western uganda, rwanda, burundi, and northwestern tanzania
description: Typical black, white, and gray batis. Note the broad black chest band and the white slash across the wing.

name: Chuuk Monarch
rangeDescription: Chuuk (eastern caroline islands)
description: Medium-sized flycatcher-like bird with a long pointed bill. Male is bright white with a black face and throat.

name: Red-shouldered Blackbird
rangeDescription: Marshes of western and central cuba and isla de la juventud (isle of pines)
description: A mostly black inhabitant of swamps and marshes. The male has a telltale orange-red shoulder patch with pale yellow trim, which the female lacks.

name: Blyth's Hawk-Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of southern myanmar to malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Medium-sized raptor of montane forests. Adult is dark brownish-black above and has heavily black-streaked white underparts.

name: Predicted Antwren
rangeDescription: Southwestern amazonian brazil (south of the amazon river and west of the rio madeira)
description: Recently described Amazonian antwren. Males are gray with a bold white eyebrow and a black crown, wings, and tail.
